FEAT-1-STORY-010.title: Expose provider search via FastAPI endpoint
FEAT-1-STORY-010.description: Implement a FastAPI route in main.py to handle provider search requests, invoke find_care_facade, and return structured results to the frontend/chat interface.

FEAT-1-STORY-011.title: Register provider search tool in tool_router
FEAT-1-STORY-011.description: Define and register provider search as an allowlisted tool in tool_router with proper schema binding, ensuring validated inputs and controlled execution per GOV-004.

FEAT-1-STORY-012.title: Normalize and rank provider search results
FEAT-1-STORY-012.description: Implement result normalization and ranking logic (e.g., distance, relevance, specialty match) to ensure consistent ordering and structured output formatting before returning results from the facade.
